extras: Performance warning advises keeping weekly notes in statically named subfolders to improve scanning performance.
intentEvidence: This plugin displays your entire life in a grid of weeks.
problem: The abstract nature of time and the finite nature of life can be difficult to visualize or reflect upon.

relations.evidence: Optionally, this plugin can integrate with the Periodic Notes plugin.
Optionally, this plugin can integrate with the Journals plugin.

summary: A visual calendar that displays a lifespan in a grid of weeks, color-coding time periods and marking weeks where a weekly note has been created.
